item.title: Fidlock GmbH Recalls Hermetic Dry Bags Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion Hazard
item.summary: This recall involves Fidlock Hermetic dry bags. The medium-sized, watertight plastic bags are clear and measure about 8 inches tall by 4.6 inches wide. They have a blue closure strip with magnets at the top and a black lanyard. “Fidlock” is printed in white on the front of the strip and lot number 2409140930201 is on the back. “Hermetic” is printed on the product packaging.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Fidlock Hermetic Dry Bags.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bags immediately and contact Fidlock USA to receive a replacement bag or a gift card for the Fidlock USA online shop. Customers who purchased the product from the FIDLOCK online store can receive a full refund in the form of a credit card refund or PayPal refund. Consumers will be asked to go to www.fidlock.us/pages/recall and send a photo of the product. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
